response.justification: Bogdan is an exceptionally talented and experienced software engineer with strong fundamentals in testing, craftsmanship, and technical leadership. However, there is a fundamental mismatch with this role's core requirements. The position requires deep C++ expertise as the primary technology, but the resume shows only 6 months of professional C++ experience from 2014-2015, with no C++ work in the last decade. Additionally, the role requires specialized industrial automation domain knowledge and industrial cybersecurity standards (IEC 62443-4-1) expertise, neither evident in the background. Recent career focus (7+ years) has been on web/full-stack development rather than performance-critical systems or embedded/industrial applications. While the candidate is undoubtedly capable of learning these technologies, the gap is too significant for immediate contribution in a mid-senior level position.
strengths: Exceptional software craftsman with proven expertise across multiple languages, platforms, and domains spanning 20+ years
Strong commitment to quality, testing, and mentoring demonstrated through extensive TDD practices, community engagement, and open-source contributions
Proven ability to architect, design, and communicate complex technical solutions; excellent documentation and teaching capabilities
concerns: Only 6 months of professional C++ experience (2014-2015); no C++ work in the last decade despite it being the core job requirement
No background in industrial automation, manufacturing systems, or specialized industrial security standards (IEC 62443-4-1, Modbus, IEC 61850, OPC UA)
Recent career trajectory (7+ years) focused on web/full-stack development (TypeScript, Node.js) rather than performance-critical systems or embedded/industrial applications

key_factors.factor: Industrial automation and cybersecurity domain knowledge
Software craftsmanship and senior-level technical capabilities
